blocks.en: In the following, we want to use the Banach contraction principle to prove an implicit function theorem for functions between Banach spaces. In order to do so, we first need to define the concept of a derivative.
blocks.zh: 下面希望利用 Banach 压缩原理, 证明 Banach 空间之间函数的隐函数定理. 为此, 首先需要定义导数的概念.

blocks.en: Naturally, we shall call a function differentiable if it is differentiable at all points of its domain. We shall use familiar notations from calculus, such as $F^{\prime}(x_0)$ or $DF(x_0)$ to denote Fréchet derivatives. We call a function continuously differentiable, if $F^{\prime}(x)$ (as an element of $\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$) depends continuously on $x$. Clearly, we can use the definition recursively to define higher-order derivatives. For example, $F^{\prime\prime}(x)$, if it exists, is an element of $\mathcal{L}(X,\mathcal{L}(X,Y))$. Alternatively, we can regard $F^{\prime\prime}(x)$ as a bilinear mapping from $X$ to $Y$, see Problem~\ref{ex:continuous-bilinear-linear-operator-correspondence}. Many of the elementary properties of derivatives can be generalized to Fréchet derivatives in a straightforward manner; see, e.g., Problem~\ref{ex:frechet-derivative-chain-rule}.
blocks.zh: 自然地, 若函数在定义域的所有点都可微, 就称该函数可微. 使用微积分中熟悉的记号, 如 $F^{\prime}(x_0)$ 或 $DF(x_0)$, 表示 Fréchet 导数. 若 $F^{\prime}(x)$ (作为 $\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ 中的元素) 连续依赖于 $x$, 则称函数连续可微. 显然可以递归使用该定义来定义高阶导数. 例如, 若 $F^{\prime\prime}(x)$ 存在, 则它是 $\mathcal{L}(X,\mathcal{L}(X,Y))$ 中的元素. 也可以将 $F^{\prime\prime}(x)$ 看作从 $X$ 到 $Y$ 的双线性映射, 见 Problem~\ref{ex:continuous-bilinear-linear-operator-correspondence}. 导数的许多基本性质都可直接推广到 Fréchet 导数; 例如见 Problem~\ref{ex:frechet-derivative-chain-rule}.

blocks.en: Let $f$ be a continuously differentiable function from $\mathbb{R}$ to $\mathbb{R}$ and let $X=Y=C([0,1])$. The mapping $f$ induces a mapping from $X$ to $Y$ by pointwise action: $\phi(t)\mapsto f(\phi(t))$. The mapping $f$ is differentiable as a mapping from $X$ to $Y$ and its derivative at $\phi$ is the linear mapping which takes the function $\psi(t)$ to $f^{\prime}(\phi(t))\psi(t)$. See Problem~\ref{ex:pointwise-composition-frechet-derivative}.
blocks.zh: 设 $f$ 为从 $\mathbb{R}$ 到 $\mathbb{R}$ 的连续可微函数, $X=Y=C([0,1])$. 映射 $f$ 通过逐点作用 $\phi(t)\mapsto f(\phi(t))$ 诱导从 $X$ 到 $Y$ 的映射. 作为从 $X$ 到 $Y$ 的映射, $f$ 可微, 且其在 $\phi$ 处的导数为将函数 $\psi(t)$ 映到 $f^{\prime}(\phi(t))\psi(t)$ 的线性映射. 见 Problem~\ref{ex:pointwise-composition-frechet-derivative}.
